note.backdrop: After Friday's close prices kept slipping in thin after-hours trading: the S&P 500 fund -0.6%, the Nasdaq 100 fund -0.8%, and no stock outside its 9-in-10 range. In the session the S&P 500 fell 0.4% to 7,561 and the Nasdaq Composite 0.9%, though all three indexes ended the week up (Kiplinger). Beneath it is rates. Wholesale prices rose 6.5% from a year earlier, the highest since November 2022; futures traders put the chance of a Fed rate rise in December at 90% (Kiplinger); the 10-year yield reached 5.17% (TIKR); the dollar reached its highest against the euro since April 2025, and AFP ties the stubborn inflation partly to energy costs from the US-Iran war. Crypto sold off across the board on Friday evening (Business Upturn: bitcoin -4.21% to $68,369 at 5:55pm ET). The check's own bitcoin line (-6.0%) and futures line (-0.7%) are measured from Thursday, not from Friday's close: Yahoo's Nov 13 daily bar for bitcoin has no close, and the futures' Nov 13 bar is held back while their session counts as open. On Yahoo's 15-minute chart bitcoin was $68,526 at Friday's 4pm close and about $67,000 at the check: about -2% since the close.

AMD fell 9% Friday, giving back part of a ~30% week, with no news of its own; Marvell -5%, Intel -3%, Arm -5%; Nvidia -2% after HSBC cut it to Hold; the 10-year yield hit 5.17% after the wholesale inflation reading; AMD at about 35 times forward earnings after the drop

singles.beneath: At Thursday's $87.75 and 14.76m shares the company was worth about $1.3bn, so $150m is about 12% of it. Shares can be sold into the market gradually, whenever the company chooses. Its updated Ewing sarcoma data are due at CTOS on Nov 19-20. The sale is public and filed, so this is not hidden information. Whether such sales weigh on the price afterward has not been tested here.
singles.cause: Inhibrx reported its third quarter at 4:02pm ET on Friday (cash $199.5m on Sept 30). Twenty-three minutes later it filed an automatic shelf that includes a $150m at-the-market share-sale agreement, dated the same day, with Stifel and LifeSci Capital. The stock fell 5.1% in the session and 2.5% after the close.

singles.beneath: The division is the part of Modine that is priced as AI infrastructure. No price, and no confirmation or denial from either company, has been reported.
singles.cause: Modine rose 27.9% on Friday on a reported Samsung approach. The evening's report says the talks concern its data center cooling division, which has a sizeable order backlog, not the whole company. After the close it slipped 1.2%.

themes.beneath: Rates. The 10-year yield reached 5.17% after wholesale inflation came in at 6.5% for the year, and traders price a December Fed hike at 90%. A higher yield lowers what stocks priced on profits years away are worth (inferred), which is why the chip group fell with yields and not only with Nvidia. AMD's valuation fell from 39 to about 35 times next year's earnings, near its five-year average (TIKR).
themes.cause: Nvidia's chief executive resigned this week amid a scandal that includes export-control probes. On Friday Nvidia fell 2.0% after HSBC cut it to Hold, and the rivals that had risen on Thursday fell harder: AMD -8.8%, Broadcom -4.8%. After the close the whole group kept slipping together: Marvell -2.7%, CoreWeave -2.6%, AMD -2.4%, Super Micro -2.1%, Broadcom -1.9%, Intel -1.7%, Dell -1.6%, Nvidia -1.1%.
themes.mechanism: Two things reach the group at once. The money that moved from Nvidia into its rivals on Thursday is leaving again: Edward Jones called it profit-taking, and TIKR says AMD gave back part of a 30% week with no news of its own. And the scandal's probes reach the server makers that ship Nvidia's chips: Singapore is investigating Megaspeed and says Super Micro gave limited cooperation, and US prosecutors are reportedly looking at whether Super Micro hardware with Nvidia GPUs reached China. Super Micro says Megaspeed was never its customer, and no one has been charged.
themes.name: AI hardware: Friday's selling carried past the close
themes.watch: Nvidia's results on Tuesday Nov 17, its first without Huang. Whether AMD and Broadcom move with Nvidia (one group being marked down) or against it (money rotating between rivals). Any charge, or any official statement, in the Megaspeed probes, and Super Micro's answer to Singapore.

themes.beneath: The page calls it broad de-risking, not one coin's news. That it shares a cause with the rate-hike odds and the strong dollar is my inference, not the page's.
themes.cause: Crypto sold off across the board on Friday evening: bitcoin -4.21%, ether -4.34%, solana -4.18% (Business Upturn).
themes.mechanism: These are the stocks that moved most with bitcoin over the past year, at about 1.1 to 1.5 times its move. After the close they fell 1.3% to 3.8%. The case file's implied falls (-6.5% to -9.2%) use the check's -6.0% bitcoin line, which is measured from Thursday. On bitcoin's -2% since Friday's close the same rates imply about -2.4% to -3.4%, close to what they did.

themes.watch: Bitcoin's weekend. These stocks reopen Monday at roughly their rate times whatever bitcoin does by then; a much larger or smaller gap would mean something of their own.
